purpose: Exercise the strict native evidence reader before any policy native outputs exist.

fixtureMethod.sourceBindings: Build 14 ordered synthetic source canonicals with privately recomputed SHA-256 values and the sealed baseline population, graph, intent, and seed fields. These are parser fixtures, not claimed native source identities.
fixtureMethod.routedRows: Use the sealed accepted15 route rows for exact schema and metrics, with independently synthetic trial source hashes and pose censuses. One synthetic area shrink and one selected TOP90 make the positive acceptance shape complete.
fixtureMethod.phaseReceipts: Construct synthetic unit8 and route28 child receipts, ordered suite markers, timing objects, terminal lines, and cleanup markers. No native JVM output is used.
fixtureMethod.negativeSemantics: Reader rejection canaries and synthetic policy-gate FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE canaries are expected outcomes. They are not trial failures or evidence about a physical layout.

positiveCases.asserts: All14 ordered synthetic canonical bindings and derived interpretation16 hashes are accepted.
All15 unchanged candidates0/2/3/4/5 across42/-1022/4 are accepted.
All14 exact saved15 rows,14 trial16 rows, and28 ordered pose censuses yield a synthetic PASS with no metric regression, one shrink, and a selected TOP90.
The exact unit8 suite order, source/raw report counts, terminal receipt, timing, and cleanup markers pass.
The exact route28 suite order, route/census report counts, terminal receipt, timing, and cleanup markers pass.

Reject reordered seed/attempt candidate branches.
Reject changed untouched candidate geometry.
Reject changed untouched candidate demand/work.

Reject reordered routed cases.

Reject the maintained CURRENT_CONTRACT_CLEANUP marker specifically.

gateOutcomes.asserts: A synthetic area increase yields strict assessment status FAIL.
A synthetic protected-empty-rectangle regression yields strict assessment status FAIL.
A synthetic copper-length regression yields strict assessment status FAIL.
A synthetic via-count regression yields strict assessment status FAIL.
No area or protected-void shrink yields strict assessment status FAIL.
A passing synthetic metric shape with no selected TOP90 yields INCONCLUSIVE.

limitations: The accepted15 file is only a sealed source for synthetic schema and route-metric fixtures here; no trial16 native result is present.
Synthetic PASS results do not certify Java contracts, planner behavior, board packability, routing, identity admission, electrical truth, replay, rendering, or player behavior.
The canary script writes no assessment.json and consumes no final policy native outputs.
